title: AI Function tasks for jobs (Beta)
body:
You can now add AI Function tasks to your Databricks jobs to run `ai_parse_document`, `ai_extract`, or `ai_classify` on the files in a volume or the rows of a table, without writing SQL. Each run processes only the inputs that are new or changed since the previous run and writes the results to a Unity Catalog table that later tasks can read. This feature is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types).

See [AI Function tasks for jobs](/aws/en/jobs/tasks/ai-functions).
